text:
Ava (AE): Quick heads-up — ClearMark renewal coming up in 3 weeks. They want to uplift from 200k tokens/day commit to 600k tokens/day and are asking for a 30% blended discount. Also asking to rebaseline pricing given higher embedding usage. Need deal desk + SE for POC acceptance criteria.

Ravi (SE): Can run a short POC for the uplift. Need to confirm: private VPC or hosted? If private, will need infra checklist and SSO + KMS details. POC success metric: sustained 300 RPS of small-gen (<=256 tokens) or <120ms p50 for chat on dedicated pool.

Marta (CSM): Customer is happy with product but price sensitivity increased after feature rollout. They're also asking for a quarterly true-up clause in the contract. They've flagged procurement timelines — want signed PO by 2024-09-15.

Ava (AE): They're on Redwood Dedicated today in us-west and using embeddings heavily for search ranking. Current commit: $45k/month (200k tokens/day). Proposed uplift: $120k/month (600k tokens/day). They want the uplift to kick in immediately on renewal.

Kenji (Deal Desk): Put the numbers in deal desk template and assign to me. 30% off blended is steep; our standard uplift tiers: 10% @ 2x, 18% @ 3x, 25% @ 4x committed. For 3x it's reasonable to offer 18% with a 12-month commit and quarterly usage reviews. Need finance & legal signoff for special billing cadence.

Luke (Finance): If we do 12-mo commit at $120k/mo with 18% discount, ARR math ok but we need to confirm revenue recognition plan. No special invoice cadence without AP approval. Also watch for invoice timing on true-ups.

Ava (AE): Can we propose 18% + a 90-day POC addendum (no extra charge) that gates the final uplift if POC fails? Customer wants guarantee on tail latency and embedding throughput.

Priya (Legal): We can do a POC addendum and quarterly true-up clause. Redlines: limit liability growth and ensure termination for convenience after 30 days post-renewal with pro-rated refunds only on unused committed credits. Also need to confirm data residency + SOC2 ISO attestation clause.

Ravi (SE): For the POC, here's a lightweight test plan I can own: 1) 48h baseline on current commit with telemetry, 2) scaled test to 3x for 72h, 3) embedding throughput test with 100k small-embed requests/hour. I'll provide logs and perf dashboard links.

Ava (AE): I'll send the POC plan and ask ClearMark for SSO details and an upcoming maintenance window. Can we request a commercial commitment term of 12 months and an opt-out at month 3 if KPIs aren't met?

Kenji (Deal Desk): Opt-out at month 3 is unusual for committed pricing. Alternative: 12-month with a 3-month performance remediation window — if KPIs not met, we provide a temporary credit or capacity boost, not price rollback. If they insist on opt-out, we need higher price or shorter term.

Marta (CSM): Customer would accept remediation + credit in principle. Their main blocker is procurement needing a cap on spend if usage spikes. They want a hard cap/guardrail. Can we add automated alerts + spend cap?

Luke (Finance): We can add spend cap guardrails but need to agree how overages are handled (prepay, POs, or auto-bill). Recommend auto-bill up to 110% then stop traffic — but that requires technical enforcement.

Ravi (SE): We can enforce token caps per API key and set alerts. For Dedicated we can throttle at the gateway. I'll add config snippet for the POC: ```
# sample guardrail config
limits:
  tokens_per_day: 650000
  throttle_behavior: soft-100ms-delay
  alert_thresholds: [80, 95]
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window posted: dedicated-us-west-2 on 2024-08-22 02:00-03:00 UTC. Affects low-latency guarantees — flag to customer.

Ava (AE): Sounds good. Next steps: 1) Kenji — put together approved commercial terms (18% @ 12mo draft) + alternative with opt-out pricing; 2) Ravi — finalize POC plan and guardrail config; 3) Priya — draft POC addendum + quarterly true-up language; 4) Luke — confirm billing cadence and overage policy. I'll loop in ClearMark procurement after internal alignment.

Kenji (Deal Desk): I'll prepare two proposal blades: (A) 18% discount, 12-mo, remediation credits; (B) 8% discount, 6-mo with opt-out at month 3. Will tag for finance approval. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Priya (Legal): I'll draft addendum and send to Ava for redlines. Need to confirm SOC2 report date and KMS provider from the customer.

Marta (CSM): I'll pre-send a short survey to ClearMark to confirm SLA expectations and procurement dates.

Ava (AE): Thanks everyone — please add any blockers here. I'll push the initial proposal to the customer after Kenji posts the blades. :rocket:
